description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Slovenia Slovenia 2026 statutory work-free facts with explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when slovenia 2026 statutory work-free dates over an explicitly selected Monday-Friday planning baseline. Seven named state holidays are not work-free; no extra Monday or bridge day is invented. Individual shifts, replacement weekly rest, employer/local/sector/school/bank schedules, religious leave, payroll, legal deadlines and future years are not computed.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2026 authority events. Requires explicit mon_fri_planning; seven named state holidays do not add rest.
Example user requests: Slovenia: Easter Monday is statutory rest. | Slovenia: Whit Monday is not Whit Sunday. | Slovenia: Science Day is a state holiday without rest.
Inputs: date (date); work_schedule (enum).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-04-06","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"} | {"date":"2026-05-25","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"} | {"date":"2026-11-10","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources, work_schedule, is_state_holiday, is_statutory_non_working_day, is_non_rest_state_holiday, personal_roster_scope, payroll_scope.
Formula: planning_workday = weekday AND no statutory_work_free_event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/slovenia-public-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/slovenia-public-working-day.md

work_schedule.description: Required explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline; not an individual legal roster.

name: check_si_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Slovenia 2026 statutory work-free facts with explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline

day_type.description: state_holiday_rest, other_statutory_rest, weekend_baseline or regular_workday; non-rest state holidays do not add rest.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_non_rest_state_holiday.description: Whether result.date is one of the seven state holidays that do not add rest.

is_state_holiday.description: Whether result.date is an article 1 state holiday, whether or not work-free.

is_statutory_non_working_day.description: Whether result.date is a statutory work-free holiday under article 1 or 2, excluding ordinary weekends.

is_working_day.description: Working date in explicit mon_fri_planning, not individual attendance.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Slovenia Working Day
